thread:
lia: Heads up — CI flagged a 403 on the runtime quickstart curl sample in docs/runtime/quickstart.md (around line ~42). Repro locally:

lia: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

docs-bot: link-checker: sample returned 403 (url: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate) — failing test: docs/samples/curl-smoketest :warning:

maria: Hmm, looks like the example is missing the Content-Type header. The smoke test sends a JSON body so the server rejects without it. Quick fix is `-H 'Content-Type: application/json'`. Also we should use the canonical hosted alias so we don't accidentally route to an internal endpoint.

ryan: This file lives under runtime guide; ownership is a bit fuzzy in CODEOWNERS. eng-runtime usually handles runtime samples, but docs team maintains the repo. @jake any bandwidth to adopt this tiny change? @maria can review.

jake: I can take it. Plan: add Content-Type header, switch to api.redwood.run alias, update the example response snippet (small mismatch), and tweak the screenshot alt text to be more descriptive. Will also bump the curl-smoketest expected status in the test fixture.

lia: thanks — CI requires the sample to pass `curl-smoketest`. One more ask: can we also update the inline note that mentions `Authorization: Bearer` to call out where to get the token (quick link to GET /tokens page) so the sample is less confusing for new users?

jake: yep, adding a tiny inline link. Opening PR in a minute. PR will include: sample change, tests update, alt text tweak.

jake: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — includes updated sample + adjusted test fixtures. pinging @maria @ryan for quick review :eyes:

maria: Reviewing now. LGTM on the header + alias. One tiny wording nit on the alt text: prefer "runtime quickstart request/response" rather than "request example" so it's clearer in a11y audits. I'll add an inline suggestion to the PR.

ryan: I'll approve once the docs-ci `curl-smoketest` passes. Thanks for picking this up @jake :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: docs-site deploy queued after merge. Watch job `docs-ci/curl-smoketest` and `docs-site/build` for results.

lia: added a short note for ownership: if a sample in runtime guide is failing CI and it's a 1-line fix, the person who opens the PR should add a `docs-owner: <team>` frontmatter tag so ownership is clearer going forward. Small follow-up, not blocking this PR.

jake: added `docs-owner: eng-runtime` in the PR and rebased. Tests passing locally, running CI now.

maria: quick approve on the main changes, left alt-text nit.

ryan: :shipit: once nit is addressed and CI green.

lia: thanks everyone — keeping this thread for the small follow-up on CODEOWNERS later.
